Breadcloth, two apples, corkflask grounded. Right bag rests behind Papa near/right hip, strap obscured by quills/front child; hidden full strap route not certified. Papa near hindleg and corrected child near hindleg now hang down near dog flank, far legs occluded. Papa supporting arm crosses child lower torso, child forepaws shoulder.
